column3: MT 23:2. “emasculated” renders “wounded by crushing”; “male organ” renders “penis.”
MT 23:3. “of illegitimate birth” renders mamzer, “bastard,” whose exact meaning is uncertain.
MT 23:6. “loves” is present for the Hebrew past “loved.”
MT 23:9. “The sons of the third generation” renders “children … a third generation.”
MT 23:11. “a nocturnal emission” renders “a happening of the night.”
MT 23:12. “at sundown” renders “as the sun goes.”
MT 23:15. “defeat your enemies” renders “give up your enemies”; “anything indecent” renders “nakedness of a thing.”
MT 23:17. “towns” renders “gates”; “where it pleases him” renders “in the good place for him.”
MT 23:21. “all that you undertake” renders “every undertaking of your hand.”
MT 23:22. NASB reverses the last two clauses.
MT 23:24. “voluntarily vowed” renders “vowed … a freewill offering”; “promised” renders “spoken with your mouth.”
MT 23:25. “until you are fully satisfied” renders “according to your appetite, your fill”; “basket” renders “vessel.”
